messages:
Elaine: Heads up — PR #728 left some orphaned snippets for kv-prefetch + small-batch flows. Need a quick triage and link hunt before next deploy. @Mike @Sam can you take a look?
Mike: On it. Point me at the files and I can do link fixes + push a docs-only patch.
Sam: Which snippets exactly? there are a few in samplegen and in the SDK examples folder.
Elaine: Paths: `docs/optimize/prefetch.md` (prefetch examples), `examples/sdk/batching/quickstart.py` (small-batch snippet). Looks like the header anchors changed so links 404.
Mike: Got it. I'll search for the old anchors and update. Also will add a small migration note on `prefetch.md`.
Jordan: FYI staging ekes out a failing test with samplegen after the last snippet rename. log: ```
FAIL tests/test_samplegen.py::test_kv_prefetch - AssertionError: expected 3 calls but got 2
```
Alex: The SDK snippet had a param rename (`prefetch=True` -> `kv_prefetch=True`) — I pushed a tiny fix in my branch but didn't wire the docs anchor.
Sam: Ok if Alex's change lands first, Mike can re-run link hunt. Otherwise I'll pick the samplegen test to debug.
Mike: I'll coordinate with Alex. Quick checklist: 1) update anchors 2) replace snippet param in docs 3) add a one-line migration note under "Breaking changes".
ci-bot: ci/samplegen — build failed (stage: unit-tests) — https://ci.redwood/1234
Alex: pushing the SDK param change now, small PR #731.
Mike: I found multiple old anchors: `#kv-cache-prefetch`, `#short-batch-example`. Replacing with `#kv-prefetch` and `#small-batch-quickstart`. I'll open a docs PR with the fixes.
Mike: PR posted: #732 — docs: fix anchors + migration note + example param tweak.
ci-bot: docs/#732 — preview deployed to staging docs (url: https://staging.docs.redwood/prefetch)
Sam: I'll run the samplegen unit locally against staging snippets and report.
Jordan: local run shows the earlier failing test passes with Alex's SDK change.
Sam: Quick sanity check done. samplegen tests + snippet examples look consistent.
Mike: Just added a tiny code sample update in the docs: ```python
# before
client.generate(..., prefetch=True)
# after
client.generate(..., kv_prefetch=True)
```
Alex: Nice. Can we also add a one-liner in the SDK changelog so users searching the repo find it?
Mike: Yup added. Link to changelog entry in PR description.
ci-bot: docs/#732 — all checks passed. preview updated.
Elaine: Amazing — can someone add a short note to the migration guide pointing to the SDK changelog? one sentence is fine.
Mike: Done — added sentence and anchor under `migration/overview.md`.
Sam: thumbs up from me, tested examples in a clean venv. :+1:
Jordan: staging preview LGTM.
Alex: will merge SDK #731 after a quick CI run.
ci-bot: sdk/#731 — build passed.
Mike: Merged docs #732 and pushed the staging rollforward commit `d4f7b2a`. Deployed to staging.
ci-bot: staging deploy — success (deploy id: 789)
Elaine: Thanks everyone! Quick win. Please ping me if anything weird pops up in the next deploy window. :tada:
Mike: np — closing the follow-up checklist in the PR and adding a short slack note to #release-war-room for awareness.
Sam: closing local branch; will watch the next CI run.
ci-bot: monitor — next full CI scheduled in 10m.
